messages:
mike: FYI we're moving forward with Azure Key Vault for envelope encryption on Private (VPC) customers. need to nail MI + RBAC model before prod rollout.

sara: quick q — should we use RBAC or legacy access policies for keys? heard RBAC is preferred but some operations are missing?

raj: short answer: RBAC is the long-term move (Azure recommends it). but note: some key operations require explicit key permissions scopes (wrap/unwrap) and role assignment granularity is different.

irene: also tenant boundary note: user-assigned MIs don't work across tenants/subscriptions — if customer tenant != infra tenant you'll need a service principal in customer tenant or a cross-tenant app registration.

mike: can you paste the minimum role we need for our app/service to do envelope encryption (wrap/unwrap + sign/verify maybe)?

raj: use the built-in role: "Key Vault Crypto User" for wrap/unwrap and sign/verify. if you need to manage keys (rotate/create) use "Key Vault Crypto Officer" or custom role.

raj: az example to assign (user-assigned MI):
```
az role assignment create --assignee <MI_CLIENT_ID> --role "Key Vault Crypto User" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<kv>
```

mike: any gotchas with network rules / private endpoints?

irene: yes — when KV has firewall + private endpoint, the MI call from our app must resolve to the private endpoint and outbound DNS must be configured. otherwise auth calls time out even if MI has role. also locking down logs makes troubleshooting harder.

sara: audit logging — we need all crypto ops in our SIEM for compliance. how to wire it up?

irene: enable Diagnostic Settings on the KV and route to Log Analytics / Event Hub / Storage. keys operations are under AzureActivity + AzureDiagnostics. retention is set in the destination (Log Analytics retention or storage lifecycle). sample: 
```
az monitor diagnostic-settings create --name kv-diagnostics --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<kv> --workspace /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/<la> --logs '[{"category":"AuditEvent","enabled":true}]'
```

mike: do we get enough detail to link wrapKey calls to our internal request id?

raj: include request id in the token or correlation id passed via our proxy and ensure the app logs it. KV diagnostic events include caller objectId and operationName (Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/wrap/action) but not arbitrary app payloads. correlate server-side logs with KV audit by principal and timestamp.

sara: rotation — team wants automated rotation every 90 days. can we use Key Vault rotation policies?

raj: yes. managed HSM supports rotation policies more fully; for standard KV you can set rotation policy on keys created with rotation enabled. also implement rewrap flow: generate new data key, re-encrypt data or store data key versions and rewrap using new key version.

mike: any cross-tenant permission flow recommendations for Private deployments where infra runs in our tenant but customer's KV is in theirs?

irene: options: 1) customer creates an app registration + grants our SP access in their tenant and we perform role assignment there (recommended for strict isolation); 2) ask customer to create a user-assigned MI in their subscription and grant it roles, then we call as that MI via workload identity federation; 3) fallback: have them export wrapped data keys to us (not recommended). document option 1 + explicit step-by-step in onboarding.

sara: security review question — does migration from access policies to RBAC break existing service principals?

raj: it can. migration requires mapping access policies to RBAC role assignments; access policies are independent and will be ignored if you exclusively use RBAC. during transition grant both until you've verified. also note some SDKs/older libraries expect access policies behavior.

eng-bot: deploybot: Reminder — KV diagnostic setting rollout scheduled for 2026-05-10 02:00 UTC to enable AuditEvent export to central LA workspace.

mike: thanks — next steps: raj + irene to draft a one-pager with MI patterns (user-assigned vs SP), RBAC role checklist, diagnostic setup steps, and rotation playbook. tag me when ready. :thumbsup:
